description: Add enable/disable toggle for MCP servers in the manage tools modal so users can disable servers without deleting them

userStories.title: Backend: Support enabled field in MCP server config
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the MCP server config to support an optional 'enabled' boolean field so disabled servers can be filtered out during tool loading.
acceptanceCriteria: MCP config dicts accept an optional 'enabled' boolean field
Missing 'enabled' field defaults to true (backwards compatible)
Tool service filters out MCP servers where enabled=false before connecting
Existing tests still pass
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Frontend: Add McpServerConfig enabled field to types
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the TypeScript McpServerConfig interface to include an optional enabled boolean.
acceptanceCriteria: McpServerConfig interface has 'enabled?: boolean' field
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Frontend: Add toggle switch to MCP server cards
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see an enable/disable toggle on each MCP server card in the manage tools modal so I can disable a server without deleting it.
acceptanceCriteria: Each MCP server card shows a Switch toggle component
Toggle is positioned between the edit and delete buttons
Clicking toggle calls onToggleServer callback with the server name
Disabled servers have muted/dimmed visual appearance (reduced opacity)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Frontend: Wire toggle to persist enabled state
userStories.description: As a user, I want my enable/disable choice to be saved so it persists across sessions.
acceptanceCriteria: Toggling a server updates the MCP config with enabled=true/false
Config is persisted via existing save mechanisms (assistant update or user defaults)
Disabled servers are excluded when fetching tools
Re-enabling a server restores its original config
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Tests and cleanup

acceptanceCriteria: Backend test: disabled MCP servers are filtered from tool loading
Frontend test: toggle updates config and visual state
All existing tests pass
Lint passes
Typecheck passes
